meta.title: MepMail Send: an email API compatible with the Resend SDK
meta.description: Transactional email and campaigns over API, SMTP and MCP. Compatible with the Resend SDK, with {checks} checks on every email, signed webhooks and plans from free. 100 emails a day free, no card.

hero.lead: The email API for your product: compatible with the Resend SDK, with an SMTP relay and an official MCP server for agents. Monthly plans, no annual lock-in.
hero.migrate: Migrate from Resend in one command
hero.note: {free} emails a day free, no card. Paid plans from {starter}/month.
hero.codeCaption: Code example. This page sends no email.

proof.lead: At {volume} emails a month, on each provider's cheapest published plan:

ways.title: Three ways to send. One account.

api.title: From your code, with the SDK you already use
api.body: Single, batch and scheduled sends, with a dedicated API key.

smtp.title: From any system that already speaks SMTP
smtp.body: WordPress, ERPs, Laravel, Django: change the outgoing server and you are done.

mcp.title: From your AI agent, with no key to paste
mcp.body: {tools} tools with OAuth sign-in for Claude, Cursor, Codex and other MCP clients.

panel.title: From the first welcome email to the holiday campaign.
panel.templatesTitle: Ready-made templates and a visual editor
panel.templatesBody: Welcome, confirmation, password, code, order, shipping, cart, receipt, newsletter and win-back.
panel.insightsBody: After a send, the dashboard shows what could push the message to spam:

insights.label: SPF and DKIM aligned with the sender
Unsubscribe through the List-Unsubscribe header on campaigns
Links on the same domain, no shortener

panel.logsBody: API logs, per-email status and delivery, open and click metrics. Illustrative example.
panel.webhooksBody: A signature on every event, with a secret you rotate in the dashboard.
panel.audienceBody: Contacts by API or CSV, properties, subscription topics and a ready unsubscribe page. Broadcasts at a controlled pace.
panel.protectionBody: Hard bounces and complaints become suppressions on their own. If the rates climb, broadcasts slow down and sends pause before your reputation burns.

agents.title: Your agent sends through the same account, with the same limits.
agents.body: Connect the hosted MCP server with OAuth, nothing to install, or run the local package with a dedicated key. Sends and campaigns reach the MCP client flagged as irreversible actions, so it asks for confirmation.
agents.configCaption: Local configuration. Replace the placeholder with your API key in the MCP client.

migrate.title: Bring the whole account with one command.
migrate.lead: The migration CLI reads your Resend account and shows, before anything changes, what comes along: domains, templates, contacts, segments, topics, properties, webhooks, suppressions and broadcasts.

plan.title: Plan with no risk
plan.body: Read-only. It writes a plan for you to review.

apply.title: Apply and verify the domain
apply.body: Publish the new DNS (DKIM and MAIL FROM). If needed, migrate rollback undoes it.

switch.title: Swap the base URL and the key
switch.body: The official SDK stays the same. Move the traffic when you are ready.

migrate.honesty: API compatibility is not full parity: inbound over the API, dedicated IPs and SSO are not part of this promise.

open.title: Open source. Use ours, or run it on your server.
open.body: AGPL-3.0 on GitHub. The hosted version runs on Amazon SES; to self-host there is a docker compose and the self-hosting guide.

plans.title: Start free. Grow by volume.
plans.lead: API, SMTP, MCP, templates and webhooks on every plan.

items.q: Do I have to rewrite my Resend integration?
items.a: No, for the supported sending calls: keep the official SDK and point it at api.mepmail.dev with the new key. The migration CLI shows what changes before you move the traffic.

items.q: What happens when I go over the quota?
items.a: Free and Starter have no overage: past the daily limit, sends wait in a queue and are refused only when it reaches 3× the limit. On Pro and Scale, overage is on and can be turned off in Billing.
No honest provider can. We verify the domain, check every email and protect the reputation; the rest depends on the content and the receiving side.
1 MB per message on Free and Starter, 5 MB on Pro and 10 MB on Scale, adding up the attachments.
No. Plans are monthly and you can cancel whenever you want, with no fee.

close.title: Your next email ships from here.
close.body: {free} emails a day free, no card. Move up a plan when the volume asks for it.
